rows.grounds: compound of mahā-koṣa-īśvarī-vṛnda-maṇḍita-āsana-saṃsthitā; internal sandhi not split

items.question: How is the goddess seated according to this description?
premises: The token describes a seated goddess.
The seat is adorned by a multitude.
The multitude consists of treasure goddesses.
items.inference: The goddess is seated on an adorned seat.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of compound members remains interpretive.
items.plain_english: She is seated on a seat adorned by a multitude of treasure goddesses.
